backend.envVarValue: bare host only, e.g. http://172.16.0.12 (no path)
backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object|null }
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> (see CLAUDE.md API rule 3) — injected globally, never per-route
notes: Real path prefix is slash-separated 3-segment '/p1/symbolicAi/<leaf>', NOT '/p1_symbolicAi/<leaf>' (underscore) — the operationId decode from the Swagger deep-link is ambiguous between the two; only the literal pasted URLs confirmed which one is real.

Each proxy route's own `path:` is just the leaf operation name (e.g. '/setColumns'); the '/api/decisionops-pod2/p1/symbolicAi' prefix lives centrally in backends.js BACKEND_PATHS, not in individual route files or .env*.
plant_code_id field placement is NOT uniform across endpoints — verify per-endpoint, don't assume. See each endpoint's `plantCodeId.placement` below.

On multipart (FormData) endpoints, EVERY scalar field is a query-param candidate until proven otherwise — only actual file(s) belong in the multipart body. Confirmed to differ even between the two multipart endpoints in this same domain (see generateMarkdown vs addEquipmentColumn).
